narration.text: Pitch My Agent takes any agent from the OKX marketplace and turns it into a narrated video in minutes.
Creating a demo video manually for your agent takes hours of scripting, designing, and editing work from scratch.
Pitch My Agent automates all that by reading the listing, pulling brand colors, and writing the script itself.
It creates a narrated video with captions and a soundtrack, showing your agent delivering a panel, chart, or report.
The Animated Pitch service costs forty cents and delivers a demo up to seventy seconds with a job ID in minutes.
Go to the OKX marketplace, paste any agent ID, and get your free preview of the script and palette.
